_about: Procedural sky (ART-09) and sunlight. All colors are linear light; the sky shader draws the gradient and sun from these, and the terrain and water use the same sun.

day._about: Day and night (WLD-11): minutes_per_day real minutes of play make one game day (48 = an hour of game time every 2 minutes). The game starts at start_hour; the sun is up from sunrise to sunset. The colours above are full daylight; dawn, dusk and night are blended in code (src/lycantrope/world/daytime.py).
